name: codex-thread-reader
description: Read local Codex conversation history by deeplink or thread ID without modifying Codex state.

interface.longDescription: Recover visible context from prior local Codex conversations using codex://threads/... deeplinks or thread IDs. The reader is local and read-only and does not expose hidden reasoning.
defaultPrompt: Read this prior Codex thread and continue from its context: codex://threads/...
List my recent local Codex threads.
Search my local Codex threads for a topic.
